reported_result: AHEAD MAPE 15% vs both simple baselines 21%. Foresight mean absolute margin of error 19%, median 11%; humanitarian plans 23% vs 19% on the matched subset. Classification: correct ~70% of the time; at the 1,200-person threshold 69% correct, 17% false negatives, 14% false positives. best_model: AHEAD ML model (15% MAPE vs 21% for baselines), but authors state predicting onset or unprecedented escalation "is difficult for the model"
